description: Use after find_marketplace_products. Preview or purchase the selected paid product by its operation_id, without searching through the full dynamic tool list.

auto_pay.description: Pay automatically with the locally configured, explicitly enabled buyer wallet.

inputs.description: Product-specific inputs returned in input_parameters or example_request by find_marketplace_products.

operation_id.description: Exact operation_id returned by find_marketplace_products, such as evm_receipt or vendor_risk_report.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE from a compatible buyer client.

preview.description: Inspect the live contract proof before paying.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.
